blurb: Guests sail on the Skyline Princess, a 120-foot, three-deck yacht with climate-controlled decks and an enclosed rooftop deck, for dinner cruises and private charters. Cruises offer views of landmarks like the Statue of Liberty, Manhattan skyline, Brooklyn Bridge, and Ellis Island. The yacht is designed for all-weather use and can host events from small groups to up to 450 passengers.

quotes.text: Leslin FraiserCarol,A sincere thanks to you and the entire crew of Skyline Cruises. You really made my husband Nygil’s 50th Birthday a memorable one.All of my guests were very impressed and had a wonderful time aboard the yacht. Brunch was fantastic as well as the hospitality of the crew. Carol, you are a very wonderful person to work with. You made everything seem so easy that at one point, I wondered if my party was going to come off, but with your assurance, I trusted you and it worked out perfectly! I am looking forward to doing this again. Many thanks and God Blessings.Leslin Fraiser

We definitely made the right decision when we chose the Skyline Princess for our parents’ 50th anniversary party. Renewing their vows on the third level, with the sunset in the background, was breathtaking. The friendly, courteous and efficient staff, the abundant gourmet cuisine, the exquisite table settings and the ambiance of the city made their party truly exceptional! Thank you for all your help, suggestions and extras. You were so accommodating to our special needs and requests. Family and friends are still talking about the spectacular extravaganza.

Estelle CooperDear Carol,On behalf of New York City Parks & Recreation and the Administrator’s staff of Flushing Meadows Corona Park, I want to thank you tremendously for the gracious reception you provided us all last night. I got so many wonderful words from all that sailed with us and I told them the thanks should go to your and your staff. Everything from the food to the rain was greatly appreciated. I’m sure we will do many future events together. Once again, many thanks.Sincerely, Estelle Cooper Assistant Commissioner, Queens

Virginia GregaDear Carol Nagy,Just wanted to let you know that we were very pleased with the Skyline Princess, its’ staff, the food, drinks, cake etc. We were also very pleased with the Maitre D’, who was very attentive to our needs and requests. It was a pleasure working with you on this event. Everything far exceeded my expectations and people are still talking about the party to this day. I want to thank you and applaud you all!Warm wishes for a Happy Holiday,Virginia Gregal J.P. Morgan Investment

MaydaDear Carol,Thank you and your staff for accommodating us. You were all very helpful and informative. It was our first event on a ship, and we appreciate your patience and are very grateful that you took us step by step through the entire process. I also want to thank the Maitre D’ William and Captain Dan for being so helpful and nice on the day of the event. We look forward to working with you all again next year!Sincerely, Mayda President- Alpha Kappa Alpha C/O Ivy Foundation

Pat NappiDearest Carol,Words can’t express my appreciation for the wonderful job you & your staff did. From start to finish you were a pleasure to deal with. You made my daughters Bridal Shower something she will always treasure. Thank you Carol, I’m still getting phone calls 3 days later from my guests, complimenting the food, the service and not the mention the wonderful cruise experience! Thank you again, from the bottom of my heart.Sincerely, Pat Nappi
